According to the evidence provided [1], asyncio is a library used for writing concurrent code using the async/await syntax. It serves as a foundation for various Python asynchronous frameworks, which are utilized for high-performance network and web servers, database connection libraries, distributed task queues, and more. asyncio is particularly well-suited for IO-bound and high-level structured network code [1].
